backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the family management app with types for user profiles, expenses, messages (with messageType, groceryItems, socialMediaUrl), permissions, reminders, media, educational materials, and public query/update functions for all features including chat, location sharing, and AI guidance.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old message format (text-only) to new Message type with messageType, groceryItems, and socialMediaUrl fields, setting defaults for existing messages.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features for enhanced messaging (grocery lists, social media links) in Chat.tsx and useQueries.ts with test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including Chat.tsx with grocery list composer, social media link input, and enhanced message rendering, plus other pages like Dashboard, MediaGallery, EducationalHub, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color palette defining CSS variables for light and dark modes with warm family-friendly tones.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title 'FamilyConnect - Stay Connected with Your Loved Ones' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with TanStack Router, ProfileSetupModal for role selection (parent/child), invitation token validation from URL parameters, and authentication flow using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AIConflictAnalys: React component that provides AI-powered family conflict detection and remedy suggestions with a toggle to enable/disable analysis and displays mock conflict data with recommended solutions.
Displays study tips and performance insights retrieved from backend queries, showing AI analysis levels, recommendations, and technology tips in card layouts.
frontend/src/components/DoubtClearingInt: Interactive Q&A interface where users can submit questions, receive AI-generated answers, view conversation history, and mark problems as resolved.
Analyzes weekly expense data across categories (Fees, Groceries, Other) and generates personalized financial insights, warnings, and tips based on spending patterns and percentages.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseChart.tsx: Visualizes weekly expenses as horizontal bar charts showing spending breakdown by category with percentages and total amount.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseInput.tsx: Form component for parents to add expenses by selecting a category and entering an amount, with validation and success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/FightsCreatedWid: Displays a card showing the count of detected family conflicts with inline editing capability. Uses hooks to fetch and update fight counters, with amber/warning styling.
frontend/src/components/FightsSolvedWidg: Displays a card showing the count of resolved family conflicts with inline editing capability. Uses hooks to fetch and update solved fight counters, with green/success styling.
frontend/src/components/HappinessMeter.t: Displays a card with a family happiness score (0-100%) as a progress bar with color-coded icons (smile/meh/frown). Fetches happiness score via useGetHappinessScore hook.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with header navigation, authentication controls, and conditional rendering based on login status. Includes navigation items for home, media, reminders, locations, chat, education, and settings.
frontend/src/components/PermissionApprov: Parent-facing component that displays pending permission requests from children with approve/deny actions. Shows activity type, reason, timestamp, and handles approval mutations with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/PermissionReques: Child-facing form component for requesting parental permission for activities (go out, play games, watch YouTube). Requires activity type, reason, and parent principal ID to submit requests.
frontend/src/components/ProblemsSolvedWi: Displays a card showing the count of resolved educational problems/doubts. Fetches count via useGetResolvedProblemsCount hook with trophy icon and badge styling.
frontend/src/components/ShareApp.tsx: A dialog component that displays the app URL and allows users to copy it to clipboard for sharing with family members. Includes instructions on how family members can join and connect.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance, creating it with the user's identity and initializing access control. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality using DFINITY's AuthClient. Manages authentication state, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, messages, locations, permissions, expenses, family management, and educational data. Exports TypeScript types for frontend data structures.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, family-friendly color palette for both light and dark modes. Includes base styles and color tokens for charts and UI components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up the React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Chat page component supporting text messages, grocery lists, and social media link sharing between family members. Includes message type selection, input validation, and displays conversation history with AI conflict analysis.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying family updates feed, role-based widgets (happiness meter, problems/fights solved, permission requests/approvals, expense tracking), and user profile information with extensive debug logging for role-based visibility.
frontend/src/pages/EducationalHub.tsx: Educational hub page with tabs for uploading question papers and answer scripts, viewing materials, AI analysis results, and a doubt-clearing interface with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/LocationSharing.tsx: Location sharing page that allows users to share their current GPS coordinates with family members and view family locations using browser geolocation API.
frontend/src/pages/MediaGallery.tsx: Media gallery page for uploading and displaying family photos and videos with descriptions, upload progress tracking, and profile-based attribution.
frontend/src/pages/Reminders.tsx: Family reminders page for creating and viewing time-based reminders with status indicators (overdue, due soon, upcoming) sorted by due date.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page component that manages user profile, family relationships (parents/children), role changes, and family invitation link generation with configurable expiration times.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, typography, animations, and warm color palette for family-friendly UI theming.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking schema version, architectural notes, known issues, and existing features for a family communication app with AI-powered analysis, sentiment tracking, and permission management.
